_comment: Template. Do not copy raw into ~/.claude/settings.json — merge by hand so project-specific perms accumulate. MCP servers do NOT belong here: the settings.json validator rejects a top-level `mcpServers` field. Configure MCPs in .mcp.json / ~/.claude.json or via `claude mcp add` — see mcp.template.json for a pinned context7 example. The `hooks` block wires: pre-git-push.sh (approval prompt on any git state mutation) and pre-secrets-guard.sh (approval prompt before reading likely secrets material) on PreToolUse; post-edit-typecheck.sh (typecheck feedback after a .ts/.tsx edit) on PostToolUse; session-context.sh (date/branch/staleness primer) on SessionStart; pre-compact-snapshot.sh (repo-state snapshot before compaction) on PreCompact; stop-dod-check.sh (debug-leftover sweep) on Stop. All are belt-and-braces on top of the corresponding CLAUDE.md rule — delete any entry to disable it. The `statusLine` block runs statusline.sh from the chip-claude clone (not junctioned separately, hence the longer path). The npm/tsc/next allow-rules below are a JS/TS default, not a universal one — swap for your stack's equivalents (cargo check/test, pytest, go test); per-project scaffolds via /chip-init already detect this automatically. `effortLevel: high` and `autoUpdatesChannel: latest` are the author's cost/stability posture, not neutral defaults — `medium` + `stable` are the conservative picks for a fork.
